commentary.text: 90+15' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+15' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+15' Augusto Batalla anticipates the direction of the penalty by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes). He attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper didn't move and denied him.
90+15' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is going to take the penalty!
90+14' Leganes aren't happy as the ref indicates they must retake the penalty!
90+13' The Leganes players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+11' Borja Jimenez is stunned as referee Alejandro Quintero shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+10' The Leganes players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
90+8' A shot is blocked but the rebound lands at the feet of Valentin Rosier (Leganes) who fires the ball into the back of the net.
90+8' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the middle of the goal, but only into the gloves of a well-prepared Augusto Batalla.
90+7' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+6' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Leganes!
90+4' Referee Alejandro Quintero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Leganes. Let’s see what happens!
90+4' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+4' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+3' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
90+2' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
90+1' The linesman raises his flag. Darko Brasanac (Leganes) is adjudged offside.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Juan Cruz (Leganes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' Good movement by Juan Cruz (Leganes), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
89' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) earns the yellow card.
89' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
86' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Alvaro Garcia.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andrei Ratiu walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
85' Dani Raba (Leganes) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

84' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Quintero no option but to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Leganes.
83' Juan Cruz (Leganes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

82' What a poor attempt! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
81' Substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) on for Oscar Rodriguez.
78' 0 - 1 Goal! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom left corner.
78' Marko Dmitrovic makes a wonderful save! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) got to the rebound and sent in a fine header to the middle of the goal, but he couldn't beat the keeper.
78' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
78' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
77' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
76' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Unai Lopez will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jorge de Frutos as he is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
75' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
73' Florian Lejeune receives a sweet cross inside the box from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
73' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

72' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
70' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
69' Dani Raba (Leganes) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
69' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle after Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
67' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' 33:67 – the latest ball possession ratio.
64' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
63' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
63' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Yvan Neyou (Leganes) for his blatant foul.
62' Adria Altimira will be replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
62' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

61' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Dani Raba (Leganes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
59' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
57' It will be a substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Randy Nteka walks off.

57' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
57' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
55' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
53' The main referee, Alejandro Quintero, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card for dissent.
53' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
53' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

52' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
50' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic.
50' Wow, what an escape. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
49' Dani Raba (Leganes) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play.
48' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
48' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
48' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Borja Jimenez gives a chance to Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) and Munir El Haddadi is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar.
45+2' Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45+2' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) is told to leave the pitch after the referee stops play and shows him a red card! His manager doesn't look happy.
45+1' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post!
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
44' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
44' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) and Andrei Ratiu attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
44' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
42' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle and it's Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to send the ball in.
42' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
39' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is able to continue to play.

39' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
39' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
37' Looks like Juan Cruz (Leganes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

37' The ball is cleared after Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Dani Raba (Leganes) was probably a bit loose with his words to Alejandro Quintero, who decides to show him a yellow.
33' Juan Cruz (Leganes) and Oscar Rodriguez try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
32' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
31' The game is interrupted. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
29' Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul after Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
28' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marko Dmitrovic reads it well and gathers the ball.
27' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Quintero signals a set piece.

25' Ambitious effort from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
23' Problems for Borja Jimenez as Seydouba Cisse is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Renato Tapia (Leganes) replaces him.
21' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) picks up an injury.
19' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
19' Half-chance! Juan Cruz (Leganes) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
18' Juan Cruz (Leganes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
17' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
16' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' It looks like Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

13' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
12' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
10' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) dribbles into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
9' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Quintero signals a foul.
7' Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
6' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
6' Leganes take a short corner kick.
5' Dani Raba (Leganes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Leganes as they win a corner.
4' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Marko Dmitrovic comfortably gathers the ball.
2' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
Leganes will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Quintero.
